abstract: Chapter 2 explores The Royal Assembly through the lens of Moksha, revealing the universal truths woven into the Mahabharata narrative.
objectives: Understand the role of Moksha in The Royal Assembly.
Analyze key character motivations in Chapter 2.
Connect philosophical teachings to real-world ethics.

content_blocks.content: The narrative of Chapter 2 centres on The Royal Assembly. The characters face choices that test the boundaries of Moksha — the cosmic order that governs all actions.

content_blocks.english_translation: You have a right to perform your duty, but not to its fruits.
content_blocks.content: This verse defines selfless action — the bedrock of the Gita's teaching.
Moksha as explored in The Royal Assembly reveals that true freedom lies in detachment from outcome while remaining fully committed to righteous action.
By the end of Chapter 2, the reader understands that the battlefield of Kurukshetra is also the battlefield of the human mind — where every soul must choose between ego and truth.
